title: The mechanism predicts characteristic photon pulses

statements.text: The proposed causal mechanism of phenomenal states is predicted to be accompanied by the emission of characteristic photon pulses, which opens a research strategy aimed at testing it and at deriving mapping rules between particular qualia and particular sets of phase-locked field modes.
